description: Sets or removes environment variables of an app (read in handlers as ctx.env.NAME). They take effect at once, without a deploy. Values are write-only: no tool returns them, only the names.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

title: Set an app's server secrets
